narrative: 把观众困在一具无法逃脱的身体里。恐慌、醉意，或解离感变成了一种空间体验，因为人物被锁定在画面之中，而街道却不会安静下来。
如果你需要的是他们所看到的第一人称视角，那么这就不是合适的工具。斯诺里康朝向的是佩戴者本身。
它不是展示世界的随身摄像机，也不是从身后跟随的镜头。
how: 使用一套安全固定的轻量化身体支架，或在虚拟场景中还原这种相对运动。保留身体的细微动作，但不要让脸独立于躯干漂浮。
提示词：斯诺里康机身固定拍摄，摄影机锁定在躯干上，脸部固定不动，身后的世界剧烈晃动。
when: 用它把观众困在一具无法逃脱的身体里。具体场景：一次惊慌失措地走在人行道上，瞳孔在画面中保持稳定，店铺橱窗在周围剧烈剪切滑动。
不要把它当作人行道的主观视角来用。
vs: 主观镜头（Point of View）展示的是他们所看的东西，视角在他们旁边或就是他们本身。手持（Handheld）是操作者在附近拍摄，而不是固定在胸前。
锁定跟踪（Locked-On）把摄影机黏附在一个主体上，这个主体不一定是佩戴者本人，常常是从车外或坠落过程中拍摄。斯诺里康则是固定在身体上，朝向演员本人。
examples_film: 《梦之安魂曲》（Requiem for a Dream）在恐慌和迷失方向的段落中使用了身体固定式镜头。《圆周率》（Pi）用固定不动的脸，让马克斯穿越城市的动作变得不稳定。
《穷街陋巷》（Mean Streets）属于同一类身体支架家族。脸是稳定的，世界却不是：这就是它的语法。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是主观镜头，或从身后拍摄的跟随镜头。破绽在于：你看到的是演员视角中的街道，或者看到的是他们的背影。
解决办法：摄影机固定在身体上，朝向脸部，背景产生剪切滑动。

faq.q: 电影中的斯诺里康（SnorriCam）是什么？
faq.a: 它是一种固定在演员身上、朝向他们本人的摄影机装置，使他们的脸保持一种诡异的稳定，而周围的环境则不断运动。

faq.q: 斯诺里康（SnorriCam）与主观镜头（Point of View）的区别
faq.a: 主观镜头展示的是这个人所看到的东西。斯诺里康展示的是这个人本身，固定在其躯干上，身后的世界则失去了锚点。

faq.q: 什么时候该用斯诺里康（SnorriCam）？
faq.a: 当恐慌、药物作用，或解离感需要把我们困在一具身体里时使用。不要把它当作拍摄街道的头盔摄像机来用。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写斯诺里康（SnorriCam）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：机身固定的摄影机锁定在躯干上，脸部居中并保持固定，背景剧烈滑动。禁止出现环境的主观视角画面。

narrative: Trap the audience in a body that cannot get out. Panic, intoxication, or dissociation becomes spatial because the person is locked to the image and the street will not sit still.
It is the wrong tool for a first-person view of what they see. A SnorriCam faces the wearer.
It is not a body-cam showing the world, and it is not a follow from behind.
how: Use a safely fitted lightweight body rig, or reproduce the relative motion in a virtual scene. Preserve tiny bodily movements without letting the face float independently of the torso.
Prompt a SnorriCam body-mounted on the subject, camera locked to the torso, face pinned, world sloshing behind.
when: Use it to trap the audience in a body that cannot get out. Concrete beat: a panicked walk down a sidewalk, pupils steady in frame, storefronts shearing.
Do not use it as POV of the sidewalk.
vs: Point of View shows what they look at, from beside or as them. Handheld is an operator nearby, not bolted to the chest.
Locked-On glues the camera to a subject that may not be the wearer, often from outside a vehicle or a fall. SnorriCam is body-mounted and facing the actor.
examples_film: Requiem for a Dream uses body-mounted shots during panic and disorientation. Pi destabilizes Max's movement through the city with a pinned face.
Mean Streets is part of the same body-rig family. Face stable, world not: that is the grammar.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Point of View or a Follow Shot from behind. The tell is seeing the street as the actor would, or seeing their back.
The fix: camera on the body, pointed at the face, background shearing.

faq.a: It is a camera rigged to the performer and aimed at them, so their face stays oddly stable while the environment moves around it.
POV shows what the person sees. SnorriCam shows the person, locked to their torso, with the world unmoored behind them.
When panic, drugs, or dissociation should trap us in a body. Do not use it as a helmet-cam of the street.

faq.q: How do I prompt SnorriCam for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write body-mounted camera locked to the torso, face centered and pinned, background sliding wildly. Ban POV of the environment.
